note: The Warden's Vault. Anything listed here is withheld from the run pools until its trigger fires; anything NOT listed is available from the first run. Unlocking is permanent per character and is what makes run 40 contain things run 1 could not.

entries.name: Penitent Chain
entries.flavour: Cut from the warden's own vigil-chain. It remembers being held.

entries.name: The Narrow Path
entries.flavour: Walked once, by someone who did not come back the same width.

entries.name: Mourner's Interest
entries.flavour: Grief, compounding.

entries.name: The Cold Room
entries.flavour: Where they laid the ones the frost took first.

entries.name: Rot In The Well
entries.flavour: They stopped drawing from it. They did not stop drinking.

entries.name: Ash In The Lungs
entries.flavour: The mire breathes out. Something has to breathe it in.

entries.name: The Ember Tithe
entries.flavour: Paid nightly, in the only currency the forge accepted.

entries.name: The Stone Saint
entries.flavour: Carved facing the door. Nobody remembers deciding that.

entries.name: Answered In Kind
entries.flavour: The prism gives back exactly what is put to it.

entries.name: A Share Of Ruin
entries.flavour: Split evenly, as agreed, between everyone still standing.

entries.name: The Last Ward
entries.flavour: The final line of the oath, struck out and rewritten in a shakier hand.

entries.name: The Kept Vigil
entries.flavour: Someone stood the whole night. This is what they were holding.

entries.name: The Long Hold
entries.flavour: Twenty rounds without setting it down.

entries.name: The Slow Count
entries.flavour: Fifty. Whoever was counting has stopped.

entries.name: The Bleeding Edge
entries.flavour: Kept sharp by use, not by care.

entries.name: The Open Wound
entries.flavour: It was never dressed. That turned out to be useful.

entries.name: Gravekeeper's Due
entries.flavour: One coin a body. The ledger balanced for a long time.

entries.name: Widow's Tithe
entries.flavour: Given by those with the least left to give.

entries.name: The Hollow Flask
entries.flavour: Drained on the stair, and never refilled.

entries.name: A Debt Of Breath
entries.flavour: Owed to whatever kept breathing for you.

entries.name: Aumbral Blade
entries.flavour: The sound a sword makes is the last thing it keeps.

entries.name: Aumbral Aegis
entries.flavour: It does not stop the blow. It stops the umbral of it.

entries.name: Aumbral Crown
entries.flavour: Worn by the one who decided the tower would hold.

entries.name: Aumbral Ring
entries.flavour: Small enough to swallow. Several did.

entries.name: Void Amulet
entries.flavour: Holds a silence the chapel could not.

entries.name: Frost Warlord's Blade
entries.flavour: Taken off the warlord, still cold.

entries.name: Umbral Dagger
entries.flavour: Carried under a vestment for eleven years without being drawn.

entries.name: Cursed Depths
entries.flavour: A worse road, and a better reason to walk it.

entries.name: The Starved Road
entries.flavour: No hearth will take you below this line.
